terminal.src/cli/**: Command-line output for the person at the terminal.
terminal.src/scripts/**: Build scripts run at a terminal, never in a deployed app.
terminal.src/plugins/test-nextly.ts: The test harness logger: error output for a test run.
terminal.src/observability/logger.ts: The structured logger's default writer; every payload reaches it masked.
terminal.src/shared/types/index.ts: consoleLogger, which masks a line before it writes it.
terminal.src/shared/lib/logger.ts: The database and auth loggers' default writers, which mask a payload before they write it.
terminal.src/domains/email/services/providers/log: The email log transport, which masks the envelope before it writes it.
